title: “Back to the Communities”: A Mixed‑Methods and Community‑Driven Evaluation of Cultural Sensitivity in Text-to-Image Models

bias_targets.methodology: Community-driven mixed-methods evaluation where evaluators from diverse cultural backgrounds assess text-to-image model outputs generated using culture-specific prompts (e.g., traditional celebrations, breakfasts, clothing) for coherence, stereotypes, demeaning connotations, and emotional responses.

Generating images using country-specific text prompts (e.g., 'a person in [country]', 'landmark in [country]') across 8 different nations, followed by qualitative and quantitative analysis by local evaluators to identify WEIRD (Western, Educated, Industrialized, Rich, and Democratic) defaults, Americanization, and the inappropriate blending of neighboring cultures.
